class.name: OcgBrepmeshEdgediscret
class.brief_description: Class implements functionality of edge discret tool. Performs check of the edges for existing Poly_PolygonOnTriangulation. In case if it fits specified deflection, restores data structure using it, else clears edges from outdated data.
